neighbours.label: What follows a verb or noun of starting or ending a long activity (beginning their third season, the start of, started his career)
fire: The twins are beginning their second year at Ohio State.
The council welcomed the start of new programs.
We are just beginning our work on this site.
She started her career as a nurse.
He ended his career as a coach.
They are starting their fifth tour of Asia.
Beginning his career as a clerk, he rose fast.
quiet: The twins are praising their second cousin at Ohio State.
The council welcomed the mayor of new towns.
We are just doing our laundry on this site.
She bought her coat as a gift.
He sold his car to a coach.
They are washing their fifth load of towels.
Selling his car to a clerk, he left fast.

predictions: The word after start or end fires; the same words after other verbs stay lower. Note that ending read nearly as high as beginning in probes.
short: after starting or ending an activity
